metadata.title: Gamedev Godot - Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for creating a Godot 4.x game from empty project to exported build using version-specific official documentation: editor/project setup, typed GDScript and C#, scene/node architecture, signals and autoloads, CharacterBody movement, TileMapLayer/GridMap, profiling and object pooling, renderer choice, and per-platform export. Godot facts drift across 4.x minor versions; volatile sources are marked add_as_web_search for live re-verification.

setup_and_project.name: Godot Docs - Introduction & Getting Started
setup_and_project.description: Official getting-started path. /stable/ is a moving alias, not a version pin; select the project minor in the documentation version selector.

scenes_nodes_and_performance.description: Read introduction: CSG is mainly intended for prototyping, not categorically forbidden in release builds. Page warns it has not been updated for 4.7; verify target-version details.
